cards.ex: I have faith in you – I know you can do it!
cards.exUz: Men senga ishonaman – bilaman, sen buni uddalaysan!
cards.uzDef: Kimga yoki nimaga ishonch bilan qaramoq, umid qilmoq.

cards.ex: I have a gut feeling that something's wrong.
cards.exUz: Nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligini ichki tuyg'uim sezmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday dalil bo'lmasa ham, to'g'ri deb his qiladigan his-tuyg'u.

cards.ex: I took his explanation at face value, but now I'm not so sure.
cards.exUz: Men uning izohini so'ziga ishonib qabul qildim, lekin hozir unchalik ishonchim yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani so'zma-so'z, shubhasiz qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: You have to earn someone's trust; it's not given freely.
cards.exUz: Siz birovning ishonchini qozonishingiz kerak; u bepul berilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlari bilan birovning ishonchiga sazovor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He betrayed my trust when he told everyone my secret.
cards.exUz: U mening sirimni hammaga aytib, ishonchimni suiiste'mol qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchni xiyonat bilan paymol qilmoq, aldash.

cards.ex: He was arrested on suspicion of theft.
cards.exUz: U o'g'irlikda gumon qilinib hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir etganlikda gumon qilinib.

cards.ex: Her honesty is beyond suspicion.
cards.exUz: Uning halolligiga shubha yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha bo'lishi mumkin emas.

cards.ex: His strange behavior raised a few eyebrows.
cards.exUz: Uning g'alati xulq-atvori bir nechta odamda shubha uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarda hayrat yoki shubha uyg'otmoq.

cards.ex: If something feels wrong, trust your instincts.
cards.exUz: Agar nimadir noto'g'ri bo'lib tuyulsa, sezgingizga ishoning.
cards.uzDef: O'z ichki tuyg'ularingizga ishonib, shu asosida harakat qiling.

cards.ex: Starting my own business was a leap of faith.
cards.exUz: O'z biznesimni boshlash ishonch qadami edi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli, noma'lum natijaga qaramay, ishonch bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I believe he acted in good faith.
cards.exUz: Men uning xolis niyat bilan harakat qilganiga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Halol va samimiy niyat bilan, aldash yoki zarar yetkazish niyati yo'q.

cards.ex: I'll give him the benefit of the doubt this time.
cards.exUz: Men unga bu safar aybsiz deb ishonaman.
cards.term: give someone the benefit of the doubt
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining aybsizligiga ishonish, hatto shubhalar bo'lsa ham.

cards.ex: I smell a rat; something isn't right here.
cards.exUz: Men nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligini sezmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki shubhali narsani sezmoq.

cards.ex: He is currently under suspicion by the police.
cards.exUz: U hozirda politsiya tomonidan gumon ostida.
cards.uzDef: Shubhali deb hisoblanmoqda, gumon qilinmoqda.

cards.ex: Blind faith can be dangerous.
cards.exUz: Ko'r-ko'rona ishonch xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday savol bermasdan, shubhalanmasdan ishonish.

cards.ex: I'm starting to lose faith in the government.
cards.exUz: Men hukumatga bo'lgan ishonchimni yo'qotishni boshlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Avval ishonch bo'lgan narsaga ishonchni yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: I heard on good authority that he's leaving.
cards.exUz: Men ishonchli manbaga ko'ra, u ketayotganini eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchli ma'lumot manbasiga asoslanib.

cards.ex: It takes time to build trust in a relationship.
cards.exUz: Munosabatlarda ishonchni qurish vaqt talab etadi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchni asta-sekin rivojlantirish, mustahkamlash.

cards.ex: Lying erodes trust between people.
cards.exUz: Yolg'on odamlar o'rtasidagi ishonchni yo'q qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchni asta-sekin yo'qotmoq, kamaytirish.

cards.ex: I'm just testing the waters before I commit to anything.
cards.exUz: Men biror narsaga sodiq qolishdan oldin sinab ko'rmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga shubha bilan yondashib, oqibatini bilish uchun harakat qilib ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Can you keep an eye on my bag while I go to the restroom?
cards.exUz: Men hojatxonaga borib kelgunimcha, sumkamni kuzatib tura olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Biror kimsa yoki narsani diqqat bilan kuzatib turmoq.

cards.ex: I question his motives for helping me.
cards.exUz: Men uning menga yordam berishidan maqsadi nima ekanligiga shubha qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining xatti-harakatlarining haqiqiy sabablarini shubha ostiga olmoq.

cards.ex: You have to take what he says with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: Siz uning gaplarini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: To'liq ishonmasdan qabul qilmoq, shubha bilan yondashmoq.

cards.ex: I suspect foul play in this deal.
cards.exUz: Men bu kelishuvda g'irromlik borligidan shubhalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri, adolatsiz yoki noqonuniy harakatlar borligidan shubhalanmoq.

cards.ex: Everything we do is completely above board.
cards.exUz: Biz qilayotgan hamma narsa butunlay halol.
cards.uzDef: Halol, adolatli va oshkora, hech qanday yashirin narsa yo'q.

cards.ex: Something about his story seems fishy.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyasida nimadir shubhali tuyuladi.
cards.uzDef: Shubhali, g'alati yoki ishonchsiz.

cards.ex: I lent him the money on trust.
cards.exUz: Men unga pulni ishonch bilan qarz berdim.
cards.uzDef: Birovning ishonchiga asoslanib, kelishuvga erishmoq

cards.ex: I keep him at arm's length because I don't trust him.
cards.exUz: Men unga ishonmaganim uchun undan uzoqlashaman.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan yaqin munosabatda bo'lmaslik, masofani saqlash.

cards.ex: We'll just have to wait and see if he's telling the truth.
cards.exUz: Biz uning rost gapirayotganini bilish uchun kutib turishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Natijani bilish uchun kutish, shoshilmaslik.

cards.ex: You need to prove yourself before I can trust you.
cards.exUz: Men senga ishonishimdan oldin, o'zingni isbotlashing kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z qobiliyatingizni yoki halolligingizni ko'rsatish.
